title: UpdateManifest
description: A provider's signed statement that a tool changed from one card to another. Optional and additive.

previousCardId.description: The id of the card this update replaces.

newCardId.description: The id of the card this update introduces.

breaking.description: The provider's own claim that the change breaks the contract.

securityImpact.description: The provider's own claim about the security impact of the change.

serverPublicKey.description: Hex ed25519 public key the manifest signature verifies against.

signature.description: Hex ed25519 signature over the canonical hash of the manifest (all fields except signature).
